ch.title: 更新说明
content: 更新移动端外壳与云端 PWA，老用户可直接覆盖升级，账号和云端数据保持不变。
优化语音输入的准备状态、就绪触感与实时声波，并提升聊天流式显示流畅度。
包含最新邀请注册、Bot 自动化、结果通知与移动端体验改进。

en.title: Release Notes
content: Updates the native shell and cloud PWA. Existing users can install over the current app while keeping their account and cloud data.
Improves voice-input preparing and ready feedback, live waveform, and smooth chat streaming.
Includes the latest invite registration, Bot automation, result notifications, and mobile experience improvements.
